verdict.rationale: Airbyte can be driven without its UI. First-party docs cover a programmatic API usable with orchestrators like Airflow, token-based programmatic access, a Terraform provider for configuration-as-code, the PyAirbyte Python library, the abctl command-line tool and Kubernetes deployment. Together these are enough for headless, automated operation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or examples for CI pipelines, independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use, and a discoverable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
